name: Hartford Audubon Society Mini-Grants
summary: Small annual grants for projects in Connecticut that benefit birds or bird habitat, with preference for Hartford County and first-time applicants. Non-members may apply.
reporting: Grantees send a follow-up report on how the grant was used and the specific expenses by the stated date; unused funds are returned.

eligibility.rule: The project benefits birds, birding, or bird habitat in Connecticut
Not a Hartford Audubon Society board member or officer

status.quote: The Hartford Audubon Society Board of Directors is pleased to announce that the following 8 applications to its 2026 Mini-Grant program have been approved.

deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted by February 15, 2026 at 5:00pm.

geography.quote: All grant proposals need to demonstrate benefit to birds, birding, or bird habitat in Connecticut.

window.quote: Applications must be submitted by February 15, 2026 at 5:00pm.

amount.quote: Grants may be requested for any amount up to $2,000 to any one recipient.

reporting.quote: Applicants are required to use the grant funds and provide a follow-up report to HAS no later than February 15, 2027.

effort.quote: Applications must be submitted by February 15, 2026 at 5:00pm.

eligibility.quote: All grant proposals need to demonstrate benefit to birds, birding, or bird habitat in Connecticut.
HAS Board members and officers are not eligible to apply.

after_award.quote: If the grant was for more than one year, please submit a progress report no later than February 15, 2027, and a final report by February 15, 2028.
